proposition: In the R. Shaqq-i Qamar Ibn Turka assigns the peripatetic philosophers (followers of Aristotle and Ibn Sīnā) to level three; on Q 54:1 they deny the sensory moon can be split and read the verse as a metaphor for union with the Active Intellect, a state they reserve for the Prophet.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, paraphrasing or translating Ibn Turka's own work
